title: Not what I was expecting!
text:
Not what I was expecting!. [[VIDEOID:37111c30c0ba2960d712bcafe5599b48]] Not very absorbent.
Fine threads on bottom, not durable
Didn’t feel like soft cotton

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
